description: Advanced ERP solutions designed for electronics manufacturers, optimizing production processes, component management and quality control while ensuring compliance with industry standards.

infoCards.title: Production Management
infoCards.description: Comprehensive electronics manufacturing and assembly management system.

infoCards.title: Quality Control
infoCards.description: Advanced quality assurance and testing management system.

faqData.question: How does the system manage component inventory?
faqData.answer: Our system provides real-time component tracking, automated reordering, supplier management and detailed inventory analytics with minimum stock level alerts.

faqData.question: What quality control features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes comprehensive quality control features with automated testing integration, defect tracking, root cause analysis and statistical process control.

faqData.question: Can it handle complex BOMs?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution manages multi-level Bills of Materials with version control, component substitution and cost tracking capabilities.
